scope: Actual published default TypeScript Temporal namespace versus temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 basic ISO/Gregorian implementation and @js-temporal/polyfill 0.5.1. Same 48 public workloads retained from previous facade benchmark. TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar arithmetic/data, host Intl Umm al-Qura and named timezones. ISO date and zoned cases; no non-ISO throughput claim. Hot operations exclude startup. Selected profiles allow independent fresh processes. No native backend installed.
method: Eight varying inputs, output parity checked before timing, 20000 warmup, 9 samples x 50000 calls; transition-specific counts retained. Selected profile: typescript. Prefer isolated profiles for comparisons. Checksum consumes outputs. Size uses esbuild es2022 minification and gzip level9; export-all TS consumer and reference namespace consumers. Profiling runs are separate from production timings.
changes: Normalized calendar addition returns epoch day plus validated fields. Pure-TS DateTime clock getters avoid eager native date metadata. Sparse field preparation uses captured Object.create with private frozen empty prototype and null parent. Original BigInt clock retained after numeric experiments regressed rounding.

referenceMeasurements.method: Retained isolated reference samples, unchanged host/versions/workload definitions. TS uses same20k warmup,9x50k;transition1k warmup,9x5k. Final close-case claims need fresh repeated reference runs.
